text: The **Hansen GFC dataset** (University of Maryland) detected the **81.3-hectare tree-cover loss** in **2021** within the asset. This was corroborated by the **JRC GFC2020 dataset**, which confirmed forest cover in the affected area in 2020, and further validated by the **MGAP 2021 forest map**, which identified the location as planted forest (*Pinus elliottii y Pinus taeda*). The Hansen dataset is the primary source for the year of the event, while JRC provided reference forest cover and MGAP confirmed the type of forest affected.
